rules.text: Every collateral carries the standard disclaimer: "Investments in securities market are subject to market risks, read all the related documents carefully before investing."
Product collateral adds its product disclaimer (Equity, Mutual Fund, MTF/E-Margin, ETF, Global Investing) word for word.
Disclaimers sit at the foot: a full-width HDFC Blue strip with small white type, or a grey "Disclaimer" block on mailers.
Never alter the logo; keep one central square ("X") of clear space; full colour on white, reversed out on dark; 35 mm / 150 px minimum.
Lead with HDFC Blue, HDFC Red, Pure Blue and white; secondary colours only as accents. Small red text uses #E81B23.
Sentence case; headlines 7-9 words, no full stop after one sentence; CTAs about 2 words (Open Account, Know More).
Photos show people, positive and bright, a moment in time; no obvious metaphors, edited images, losses or disasters.
No invented market figures, returns or customer counts; a product figure carries its source and disclaimer.
